acceptanceCriteria.text: The Add-folder action is AVAILABLE inside a room Files collection (not only on real on-disk folders), creating a NESTED room folder. @390 screenshot: opening a room Files collection shows an Add-folder affordance; firing it creates a nested folder.

★ LOCKED (Tron 2026-09-01, asked directly, verbatim: PER-USER, each member own): a nested room folder lives under EACH MEMBER own room dir = getRoomDir(userToken,roomId)/files/<nestedPath>/ (per-user, storageId-keyed), mkdir THROUGH the R40.22 homeKeyFor chokepoint, NEVER a raw mkdir — matching how room storage works today. NO share/sync machinery (option ii CANONICAL-per-room was NOT chosen). The chain (Class/Method) is now buildable; architect mints it; fresh expert builds AFTER part 2 ships.

Once the storage target is defined: Add-folder-in-room mints the folder scenario-UNIT **AND** mkdirs the REAL directory at that per-room target (same Tron BOTH ruling as R40.70 part 2). Fail-clean: dir-exists / invalid-name / mint-fails-after-mkdir => leave nothing behind (half-created worse than failed).

The nested room folder appears LIVE in the room tree with NO reload [browser 1] AND a second browser updates over WS [rides R40.70 AC-create-live-no-reload + AC-broadcast/2nd-passive-client]. reload-to-see = FAIL; single-browser-only = FAIL.
The nested room folder is a REAL Folder scenario-unit (rides R40.16, NO duplicate folder model).

stub-must-fail: (1) Add-folder-in-room creates a unit but NO physical directory (or a directory but no unit) => RED; (2) mkdir NOT through the R40.22 chokepoint / a RAW path => RED; (3) the nested folder placed anywhere OTHER than the LOCKED per-user getRoomDir(...)/files/<nestedPath> (e.g. a canonical-per-room shared path) => RED. (The prior undefined-target-=>-RED is RESOLVED: the target is locked per-user; the stub now asserts the LOCKED target, not the open question.)

Tron (screenshot @v0.8.165): Add-folder is TOTALLY MISSING on the room Files folder detail — drawer shows only Scenario and Edit. AC: on 390px, the Add-folder verb APPEARS on the room Files folder detail (in the ROOM context) and works. Screenshot: the Add-folder control is visibly present, not absent. (Root cause measured by architect: add-folder was a /MODEL-view verb, never offered in the room context = service-built-but-UNWIRED.)

Per Tron, RESOLVED by architect re-rule (f6f1463e0): the room Files node resolves to the REAL per-user directory getRoomDir/files (NOT virtual, NOT synthesised). The Files collection IS that physical folder. Nested folder location = REAL relpath under getRoomDir/files; the logical roomcoll-ref location is RETIRED.

Add-folder inside Files = the ORDINARY physical-equals-BOTH case: mint the Folder unit AND mkdir the real subdirectory at the room's per-user files dir, exactly as add-folder works anywhere else. NO nested-virtual, NO separate logical/real location, NO exception.
Per-user isolation stays as ruled — the room storage is already per-user (R40.22 chokepoint, Tron-locked). Add-folder writes to the acting user's room files dir.
The verb routes to the ROOM folder-create path (RoomFilesService), NOT /api/model/folder/create — the surfacing+wiring the architect measured as missing.
Live-MVC no-reload + 2nd-browser-WS: the new subfolder appears without reload via publishUnitChanged on the ROOMCOLL PARENT ref (shared with P2). 2-browser: shows live in both.
Fail-clean, no half-state (architect 6-case atomicity): a failure leaves neither an orphan unit nor an orphan dir.

The nested Folder unit's location is a REAL relpath under getRoomDir/files (mirrors the on-disk subdir). The earlier LOGICAL roomcoll-ref location is RETIRED — one real location, no logical/real split (consistent with Tron: Files IS the physical folder).

DRY (Tron standing law): the ROOM add-folder and the MODEL add-folder call ONE shared folder-creation MECHANISM (mkdir + mint both-or-neither, the 5 failure paths + 12/12 backstop of createPhysicalWithUnit), differing ONLY in which PARENT PATH they resolve (room=getRoomDir/files vs model dir). The two that exist today (createPhysicalWithUnit + addNestedFolder) CONVERGE to ONE — addNestedFolder must delegate to the canonical mechanism, NOT be a parallel mkdir-plus-mint. A second implementation => a second set of atomicity bugs + a second rollback path + only one backstopped => RED.

gateRef.assertion: the mkdir+mint PAIR (fsSync.mkdirSync leaf + unit writeFileSync persist) appears in EXACTLY ONE place (createPhysicalWithUnit) and 0 elsewhere; a 2nd occurrence of the pair (incl a lingering addNestedFolder copy) => RED. Hazard names itself (raw mkdir-then-persist outside the core) = unevadable, no discovery mechanism needed.

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): seed a 2nd mkdir+mint pair (or a lingering addNestedFolder copy) outside createPhysicalWithUnit -> the lint goes RED. Converts we-agreed-DRY into the-build-fails-if-we-arent. Architect backstops the lint + the ONE core on generalization.
